notes.title: Where to watch our devlogs and progress on the game
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]

If you wanted to stay updated with the progress of the game, there is a playlist on my personal channel where I regularly update with content completely focused on The Lavarish Facility! 

This Playlist is regularly updated with new content such as Devlogs, Funny moments during development and Announcements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45593875/e6ddf52c20fccd7081481390e1202f9d76911567.png[/img]

[h2]Check it out if you have time![/h2]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLFg1udJFEl47a1QfI7C5cgBbABRY0cKdC]Watch the playlist![/url]
